programme.title: Great Barrier Reef with David Attenborough

He also learns about a complex community of animals, as well as the annual coral spawning, which is responsible for the great diversity in the reef.

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef with David Attenborough

He also marvels at manta ray cleaning stations on Lady Elliot Island, and tracks dwarf minke whales to discover their surprising reasons for returning, and why the reef is vital for their survival.

programme.title: Great Barrier Reef with David Attenborough
programme.desc: The naturalist examines what the next few decades may hold for this remarkable ecosystem, and looks at the work of scientists who are trying to preserve the area and the species that inhabit it, assisted by research vessel the Alucia. programme.title: UEFA Champions League - Classics

programme.title: UEFA Champions League - Classics
programme.sub-title: Action from the 1996 Champions League Final

programme.title: UEFA Champions League - Classics
programme.sub-title: Borussia Dortmund v Juventus in the 1996/97 final

programme.title: UEFA Champions League - Classics
programme.sub-title: Real Madrid v Juventus from the 1997/98 season

programme.title: UEFA Champions League - Classics

programme.title: UEFA Champions League - Classics
programme.sub-title: Real Madrid v Bayer Leverkusen in the 2001/02 final

programme.title: UEFA Champions League - Classics

programme.title: UEFA Champions League - Classics
